questions.stem: In the erector spinae plane block, which three muscles make up the erector spinae group?
options: Trapezius, rhomboid major and serratus anterior

questions.stem: In the erector spinae plane block, where do the erector spinae muscles run?
questions.answer: Both sides, from skull to pelvis and sacrum; spinous to transverse processes, reaching the ribs
